title: The Perfect Woman: A Proposition
summary: Chapter 13 begins with Mangchi's ‘Keep That Fire Alive,’ a failed hidden-guest prank and a short video-shoot-day episode with model/creative collaborator Charm Killings and Steve Lee. It then moves through body and identity questions, David Choe's diabetes and disordered-eating disclosures, Charm's relationship boundaries, David's television résumé, public recognition, a private cabin story, online dating and the title's long stripper proposition. The ending returns to opportunity/readiness coaching, Charm's Model Citizen Fund plug and a Mangchi hammer advertisement. The machine cleaner reduces 1,922 raw segments to 1,886 clean segments but increases the approximate word count from 16,029 to 16,050. That is not invented dialogue: around 1:25:51, a repeated ‘Sheen’ decoder failure is consolidated into several honest multiword `[indistinct audio - not transcribable]` markers, whose descriptive labels contain more tokens than the hallucinated one-word fragments. The cleaner records 43 edits—empty artifacts plus the terminal degenerate run. The substantive transcript improvement is a separate 462-decision human fixture covering the entire 1:28:18. Charm's contribution is not reducible to ‘perfect woman’ body appraisal. She arrives for a failed scare, dances, improvises, takes scissors to a costume and begins art-directing the Mangchi video shoot. She self-identifies as Portuguese, Black and German and says she identifies more as Black; the room's code-switching prompt does not override her own terms. She describes eating what she wants in moderation, being friendly but not inviting, receiving attention from different groups depending partly on styling, valuing privacy around her boyfriend, preferring relationships while remaining highly independent, enjoying security, cooking through a family restaurant background, and valuing humor and goals over guaranteed success. Her refusals and privacy-preserving answers control when the room presses sexual history, her private boyfriend's identity/genitals, the number of relationships, or whether she would join public sex. Appearance-based claims about her diet, ethnicity, intelligence, genetics or attraction are not objective facts. The medically consequential section is unusually important. David says testing connected to sexual-health concerns revealed diabetes, and reports being told it could be ‘reversed’ through no carbs and no white foods. The exact diabetes type, test and clinician advice are not available. Modern American Diabetes Association guidance uses remission criteria for type 2 diabetes and supports multiple individualized eating patterns; it does not require all people with diabetes to eliminate carbohydrates. David then describes self-induced vomiting escalating from monthly to weekly to daily, a supposed 20-minute window before food enters the system, and a shift to chewing food nearly liquid and spitting it out. MedlinePlus identifies bulimia as a serious eating disorder and documents enamel erosion, esophageal injury, dehydration and dangerous electrolyte imbalance from repeated purging. The 20-minute cancellation rule is unsupported. Television appearance pressure, liposuction or eating vegetables/smoothies does not make purging or chew-and-spit behavior safe. His claim that nearly every Los Angeles woman has an eating disorder and that it is a white-girl behavior is anecdotal stereotyping, not prevalence evidence. The editorial layer preserves the disclosures as a health/recovery signal, corrects the false guidance and does not diagnose Charm or any private woman. Career claims are separated by evidence level. CNN's official transcript confirms David in Anthony Bourdain's *Parts Unknown* Koreatown episode and the Sizzler sequence, including his explanation that Sizzler represented special-occasion Korean American family history. It does not verify that the episode was the season's most watched, that later Netflix availability changed because of DVDASA, or that Sizzler made a finalized spokesperson deal. The Television Academy confirms *VICE* on HBO received program nominations including 2014 nonfiction cinematography for ‘Greenland Is Melting/Bonded Labor’; it does not establish David personally as an Emmy winner. The transcript's count of his television appearances also contradicts itself. Those distinctions preserve a real career-opening story without converting bravado into résumé fact. David's stronger media thesis survives: brands should inspect the artist's actual work before partnering; he prefers an authentic Koreatown memory over fabricating a fashionable restaurant history; DVDASA's rawness creates relationship and career costs yet remains the format he refuses to abandon. Public recognition is likewise mixed. A fan group's enthusiastic interruption helps David signal status to a private woman, but repeated approaches after a photo and conversation cross his stated limit. Charm challenges his harshness. The woman, fans, private boyfriend, venues and accounts stay protected. A public figure can appreciate recognition sometimes and still refuse access at other times. The private cabin story includes a woman who reportedly mentioned interest in two men, David repeatedly refusing to shower, Steve admitting he secretly watched sex, and later genital-touch discussion. A past statement is not blanket consent to observation, publication or another act. The title story begins in a strip club with a reportedly 20- or 21-year-old worker, a 15–16-year age gap, paid lap dances and alleged owner tips about which workers provide off-menu sexual services. Those private-worker claims and venue networks are not independently verified or publishable as a guide. In the VIP room, David requests manual sex and she says no. He initially says ‘oh well’ but continues into an income inquiry and paid-access proposal: $1,600 per week, double a reported $800 monthly income, in exchange for being available while nominally free to strip or date others. She anticipates the offer, says ‘it's not happening,’ calls it disgusting, says she is not a hooker, says he is making things weird, and repeats no many times. David keeps presenting the full pitch, asks her to think about it, and frames patience as waiting people out. Absence of physical force does not erase economic and conversational pressure. Four years later she reportedly contacts him under bereavement, medical-debt, concussion and other financial stress. He rejects her as older and no longer ‘sweet and innocent,’ then admits desperation can make someone say anything. Her later crisis does not retroactively invalidate the earlier refusal or prove the offer was right. Charm's observation that the story may be told to prove David right is retained. The useful opportunity thesis is kept within its proper domain: prepare before a creative opening, answer many opportunities knowing most fail, arrive early, build fitness for touring, and have goals even before success. It must not be transferred to sex or public access; urgency, persistence, status, friendship, economic need, silence, delay, eyes or past statements do not create consent. David asks whether he is pushing Steve too hard, and Steve says no and reports feeling more confident. That evidence matters, but it sits inside the continuing employer/benefactor relationship and does not validate every body or sexual pressure. Model Citizen Fund's own site corroborates its stated mission of distributing backpacks with 150 items to homeless people and disaster victims. The record treats the two-week durability and efficacy as organization/guest claims, not independently audited outcomes. The outro repairs Charm Killings, Mangchi, Kwangou/Kwangu and Scion Audio Visual candidates, while the final Mangchi hammer advertisement stays non-quotation-grade around the decoder defect. All explicit, offensive and contradictory ideas remain in the source layer. The editorial layer fixes words, marks provenance, protects private people and prevents medical, career, consent or charity claims from silently becoming facts. No named line-level dialogue publishes because the episode has zero held-out identity windows and zero acoustically validated turns.

connections.note: The opening performance supplies a relationship-revival song before the episode turns to public and transactional intimacy.
Dance, costume improvisation, scissors and spontaneous art direction make the guest a video collaborator rather than only a body subject.
ADA guidance separates individualized carbohydrate management and formal remission criteria from the episode's universal no-carb shorthand.
David's monthly-to-daily purging and later substitution form a direct health timeline, with MedlinePlus correcting the twenty-minute myth and documenting serious risks.
CNN corroborates the Koreatown/Sizzler sequence and David's special-occasion family explanation.
Television Academy records support program nominations while rejecting the simplified personal Emmy claim.
The Sizzler choice is grounded autobiography, while ratings, availability, spokesperson and award claims require separate evidence.
David describes the show as relationship-damaging and commercially risky yet inseparable from the format he values.
A fan's status signal helps one social interaction, then repeated returns exceed David's limit and prompt Charm's criticism.
Charm's subtle posting, parent/fan fantasy pressures and another girlfriend's harassment show why public identity does not require public partnership.
Price comparisons, reciprocity inferred from eyes and private workers continue earlier transactional-intimacy themes without becoming a guide.
Genital size, mixed-heritage intelligence and hybrid-animal claims misuse anecdote and evolutionary shorthand.
A past two-men statement, shower refusals and secret observation demonstrate that interest in one act does not authorize surveillance or publication.
The title story combines a young adult worker, direct refusals, income disparity, a weekly retainer, four years of waiting and later crisis-driven contact.
David explicitly doubles a reported monthly income and later recognizes that desperation can make someone say anything.
A valuable creative maxim—prepare before the opening arrives—must remain separate from sexual persistence and public-access entitlement.
Early arrival, tour fitness, social comfort and stated positive change coexist with benefactor/employer control.
The organization's own site supports the 150-item backpack mission claim, while duration and impact remain unaudited.
The outro links the one-day video shoot to Steve's album and likely Scion Audio Visual release context.
The hidden prank, dance, art direction, costume, body positioning, approach reenactment, finger damage, hands-up sequence and Ring Around the Rosie require video.

CNN's official transcript verifies the September 2013 *Parts Unknown* Koreatown/Sizzler sequence and David's explanation of Sizzler as a Korean American family special-occasion restaurant: https://transcripts.cnn.com/show/abpu/date/2013-09-14/segment/01
CNN's series page places Koreatown in season one: https://edition-prod-cf.sitemirror.cnn.com/videos/title-979271

The Television Academy lists *VICE* program nominations, including 2014 nonfiction cinematography for *Greenland Is Melting/Bonded Labor*. It does not prove David personally won an Emmy: https://www.televisionacademy.com/shows/vice and https://www.televisionacademy.com/awards/nominees-winners/2014/outstanding-cinematography-for-non-fiction-programming

The American Diabetes Association says carbohydrates can be part of diabetes eating patterns and should be individualized, and defines type 2 remission through sustained laboratory criteria rather than casual reversal language: https://diabetes.org/about-diabetes/diabetes-myths and https://diabetes.org/newsroom/international-experts-outline-diabetes-remission-diagnosis-criteria

MedlinePlus documents bulimia as a serious eating disorder and identifies enamel erosion, esophageal injury, dehydration and dangerous electrolyte imbalance from repeated purging: https://medlineplus.gov/ency/article/000341.htm

Model Citizen Fund's own site states its mission is distributing backpacks containing 150 items to homeless people and disaster victims. This corroborates the organization's claim, not independent efficacy: https://modelcitizenfund.org/

The exact Keep That Fire Alive arrangement, 3nder pronunciation, VICE segment titles/role, Sizzler spokesperson offer, adult-awards event, Kwangou/Kwangu spelling, outro phrase, Scion release context and terminal Mangchi lyrics remain verification candidates.
Zero held-out identity windows and zero validated turns means no line-level speaker names. Episode-level cast context is not acoustic identity evidence.
